title: How to Build an iOS App in Minutes with Claude AI Zero Code #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #aitools
description:
You can now build and launch a complete iOS application using Claude AI without writing a single line of code! In this video, I break down the exact 4-step workflow that allows anyone to create and publish a fully functional mobile app.

Building an app is no longer about knowing how to code—it is about knowing the right AI workflow.

Here is the exact 4-step app building process

Step 1 - Open Claude Code and ask it to install React Native and Expo. This sets up everything you need to build both iOS and Android apps from a single codebase.

Step 2 - Ask Claude to build the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) of your app first, then continue prompting it to add new features and retention loops.

Step 3 - Test the app in your browser and scan the provided Expo QR code to preview it directly on your physical phone.

Step 4 - Ask Claude to generate your App Store title, description, certificates, and professional screenshots. Then simply submit it to Apple for review!
